segments.text: The Earth stops. For one second.
Right now in New York, you're spinning at {seven hundred ninety miles per hour|*790 MPH*}...
and you don't even feel it.
People, cars, everything flies *east* at {seven hundred ninety miles per hour|*790 MPH*}.
In that one second, you'd fly over {a thousand feet|*1,000 FEET*}.
The *oceans* keep moving too. Walls of water surge over the coasts.
Then the *wind.* Faster than *sound,* three times any hurricane on record.
For one second, the entire *atmosphere* scours the surface.
Up there, you're barely moving at all.
